summary: Iterates a scene count held at this offset 0xD80 and, for each scene, processes one of two 864-byte source blocks of the global array unk_7D1448. Each block yields 8 sub-elements of 27 floats; for every sub-element it computes double the value at float index 9 and stores the clamped result plus source float 0 and float 18 into a destination buffer (this + 866 for the first scene pass, this + 1121 for the second) via CollisionParameterClampAndStore. Returns the final loop counter.

operations.description: Read the scene count from this at dword offset 0xD80 and use it as the outer loop bound.
When the count at this offset 0xD80 is not positive, skip all processing and return immediately.

Outer loop over the scene count: for pass index 0 select destination this + 866 (float index) and source block 0 of the global unk_7D1448; for pass index 1 select this + 1121 and source block 1 (864 bytes into unk_7D1448).

Inner loop over 8 sub-elements per block: compute v7 as v6[9] + v6[9], call CollisionParameterClampAndStore(destination, sub_index, v7, v6[0], v6[18]), then advance the source pointer by 27 floats per sub-element.
Return the loop counter after the outer loop completes.
